pending_hybr_before_withdrawal.meaning: amount of pending HYBR accumulated in the contract before the withdrawal

withdrawer_shares_before_withdrawal.meaning: gHYBR shares held by the withdrawing user before calling withdraw

withdrawal_occurred.meaning: a withdrawal by the share holder occurred

pendings_present_at_withdrawal.meaning: pending HYBR balances are present in the contract at the time of the withdrawal

lesser_dilution_observed.meaning: lesser dilution occurs on the withdrawal because the withdrawer's claim excludes pending HYBR

assumptions: The withdrawing user is any gHYBR share holder calling withdraw(shares); no additional authorization beyond holding shares is stated.
Pending HYBR P is a contract-held balance separate from the veNFT locked amount and is not included in totalAssets().

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric formula for the fair proportional share of pending HYBR, so the proportional-fairness relation cannot be expressed as a cross-multiplied amount inequality; only the qualitative lesser-dilution outcome is representable.
Whether pending HYBR P is nonzero in any concrete observed withdrawal is not established; the scenario is conditional on P > 0.

limitations: The impact is potential and conditional on pending HYBR being present; the relation is only asserted under that condition.
The lesser-dilution effect is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report supplies no numeric fair-share formula.
Other impacts (withdrawers_lose_proportional_share) are not formalized in this plan.
